patch_description: Builds on the current best (single shared parameter "theta" driving RX, RY, and RZ layers on all 8 qubits, giving each qubit a full three-axis rotation from just one trainable scalar per repetition — the proven floor of n_params = 8 given the fixed 6-fold repetition and 2 fixed readout params). The entangling structure is enriched from the previous degree-3 graph (nearest-neighbor ring + antipodal diameter links) to a degree-4 graph by additionally inserting fixed, zero-parameter "skip-2" CZ links (connecting qubit i to qubit i+2). This denser fixed entangling graph increases the circuit's expressive/correlation power at absolutely no parameter cost, which should further accelerate convergence and improve robustness/generalization on very few training examples, while keeping parameter economy at the demonstrated optimum (n_params = 8).
